objective: Turn the X1 contract layer into an executable deterministic synthetic/reference whole-plant model: 16 admitted scopes as composition participants (explicit_lagged, no same-window feed-through), the 9 frozen X2-active C1 controls as deterministic rule/sequence logic (including the mandatory X1-C01 actuator commands), the frozen topology/provenance (3 PIM-known + 15 assumed edges), balance/bounds/non-negativity guarantees and the required oracles - while preserving exactly ONE canonical SH-WTP RuntimeSession and the existing G13/G13B/G14/G15/G21/G22/G23/G24/G25 behaviour.
explicit_non_objectives: No PI/PID dynamics, no integrator/derivative/scan loop of any kind
No T107 activation (T107 stays excluded from X2)
No rich SH-WTP UI (Frame A/Frame B are X5/X6)
No second RuntimeSession / RunLifecycleService / run id / clock authority
No PIM write and no new canonical PIM id
forbidden_paths_note: tests/ is intentionally NOT a whole-directory forbidden entry (the new X2 test module is a required deliverable, so the allowlist confines changes to that single test file); every other test module is protected by the allowlist and none may change. The frozen X1 contracts/configs and the accepted SH-WTP runtime modules must not change: X2 is implemented additively next to them.

forbidden_actions: Evaluating any PI/PID equation, integrator, derivative term or controller scan loop
Activating T107 or any excluded scope
Adding scopes, controls, edges, fidelity or topology outside the X2 admission manifest
stop_conditions: The admission manifest cannot be implemented without changing the platform lifecycle/session/run architecture
Runtime behaviour needs a topology/scope/control choice not frozen in X1
A C2 loop appears necessary merely to make X2 runnable
A required X1 contract proves physically inconsistent rather than merely parameterizable

acceptance_criteria.description: Exactly one canonical SH-WTP RuntimeSession/run authority drives the whole-plant model through the accepted bridge
All 16 admitted scopes execute as contracted; no excluded scope (T107 / ELEC-MCC / AUTO-PLC / LINE2 internals) executes
All 9 frozen C1 controls are active and zero C2 loop evaluation occurs
Every X2 process input resolves at runtime without hidden fallback invention (X2-active C1, process node, scenario or explicit declared fallback)
Storage/plant water balance is exact/bounded, no negative flow or volume exists, and all states stay within declared bounds
Deterministic trajectory for identical inputs/reset; explicit_lagged with no same-window feed-through
Plausibility: filtered turbidity <= settled turbidity; filter DP non-decreasing between backwashes and reset after a valid backwash
Assumed-edge provenance is visible in runtime records; every output stays site_truth=false / synthetic_reference
X1-C01 actuator behaviour is preserved exactly (RAW-INTAKE 75/0, T106 valve 100/0, T108 70/0, DIST-P108 80 fallback, T100/T108 direction)
R1-R5/UX01/X0/X1 regression and the full suite remain green
